arabic text: ATH PEHAR BHIRAWAN DIYAN LASHA TE NAA AAIYAN.
english translation text: How helpless the daughters of Zahra became— for eight watches of the day they could not reach their brothers’ bodies.

arabic text: AZANAN ICH NANAY DA JADON NAAM SI AAYA\nBAHUN ROIYAN SUN KE BAZAAR DE VICH FATIMA\nJAIYAN.
english translation text: When their grandfather’s name was\nheard in the call to prayer, Fatima’s\ndaughters wept bitterly in the marketplace.

arabic text: OH JINHAY DI PARDAY DI QASAM CHANDA KHUDAH\nHAI\nUMMAT NE OH SHEHZADIYAN SIR NANGAY TURAIYAN.
english translation text: God Himself swears by the modesty\nof those ladies, yet the community\nmarched those princesses bareheaded.

arabic text: DARBAR ICH PAISHI HAI ALI MOLA DI DHI DI\nLOGAN NE SARAY SHEHAR DIYAN GALIYAN SAJAIYAN.
english translation text: Ali Maula’s daughter was presented in the tyrant’s court,\nwhile the people decorated every street of the city.

arabic text: SAJAAD EH KEHNDA SI CHIRAGHAN NUN BHUJAO\nAAJ GHAZI DIYAN BEHNA NE BAZAAR VICH AAIYAN.
english translation text: Sajjad kept saying, ‘Extinguish these lamps—\ntoday Ghazi’s sisters are being brought through the marketplace.’

arabic text: NO MEEL TURRI SAIN KEEWEIN PEHRE TE AAGAY\nCHON TARF TO GHAIRIYA KINJH GHUSTAK SIPHAIYAN.
english translation text: How did the Sayyida walk nine miles on foot?\nOn every side she was surrounded by insolent soldiers.
